title: Common target trivializations and minimal source model
statement: Let f:X→S and fi:Xi→S (i in Fin n) be flat proper locally finitely presented morphisms with ui:Xi→X over S. Assume their tensor-pullback structure-module adjunction units are universally isomorphisms. Let L be invertible on X, k:W→S an immersion, w in W, s=k(w). Assume each pullback Li over W descends from a finite locally free module and the source bundle on X_s descends from a finite locally free module on Spec kappa(s). Fix derived localization instances for every scheme and every localized open site. Put E=R(f_W)_*(L_W[0]). There exist an affine neighbourhood U of w on which every Li is trivial on Xi×S U, m≥0 and a bounded complex K on the localized module site over U. For each integer j, K^j is isomorphic to O_U raised to derivedFiberBetti(W,E,j,w); these Betti numbers vanish for j<0. There are section bases e0:Gamma(K^0)≅A and e1:Gamma(K^1)≅A^m, A=Gamma(W,U), and a derived isomorphism from E restricted to U to Q(K). Every coordinate of e1(d_K^0(e0 inverse(1))) evaluates to zero at w. No joint degree-one map or cohomology comparison is asserted.

source.place: Tag 0BF2, proof before the joint H-one injectivity argument; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BF2

proof.text: For each i, uniqueness of left adjoints compares tensor pullback along ui with ordinary pullback and transports invertibility of L. Apply the descended-invertible neighbourhood lemma using hOi and hLi. Take the finite intersection of these opens; it contains w, including when Fin n is empty.

For L_W, compare tensor pullback with ordinary pullback and transport invertibility. The sheaf-level invertibility bridge gives finite presentation, and invertibility over a flat morphism gives relative flatness. The perfect direct-image base-change theorem gives perfectness of E. Apply the marked-fibre Betti lemma for negative vanishing and beta_0=1. The Lean perfectness input now comes directly from properFlat_single_derivedDirectImage_perfect, with the existing finitely presented relatively flat coefficient and the supplied derived localizations. No base-change conclusion of the retired combined theorem is required for this step.

Apply exists_finiteFreeResidueModel to E. Choose an affine open inside its intersection with the common target neighbourhood. Restrict the complex by overMap. Exact restriction preserves zero terms, overMapUnitIso and preservation of finite coproducts preserve every free rank, and overFunctorMap together with derived functor composition transports the comparison. This is the explicit private refine_residue_model proof in the delivered module.

Evaluate the given degree-zero free isomorphism on the terminal localized open; beta_0=1 and piUnique give e0. Evaluate the degree-one free isomorphism and remove ULift from its finite coordinate index using piCongrLeft to get e1, with m=beta_1. Apply the residue-rank differential lemma to t=e0.symm(1). Assemble U, the target trivializations and all the retained model data.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0B91(2), 0A1H and 0A1D; B3 retirement adaptation uses the existing perfectness-only and canonical module base-change declarations, without changing the statement.

theorem picard_h1_common_minimal_model
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{v},
      HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Y : Scheme.{v}) (U : Y.Opens), HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1}
      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S) {n : ℕ}
    (Xi : Fin n → Scheme.{v}) (fi : ∀ i, Xi i ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    [∀ i, Flat (fi i)] [∀ i, IsProper (fi i)] [∀ i, LocallyOfFinitePresentation (fi i)]
    (ui : ∀ i, Xi i ⟶ X) (hui : ∀ i, ui i ≫ f = fi i)
    (hO : ∀ {T : Scheme.{v}} (g : T ⟶ S),
      IsIso ((Classical.choose
        (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f g))).unit.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf)))
    (hOi : ∀ i, ∀ {T : Scheme.{v}} (g : T ⟶ S),
      IsIso ((Classical.choose
        (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd (fi i) g))).unit.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf)))
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (W : Scheme.{v}) (k : W ⟶ S) [IsImmersion k]
    (w : W) (s : S) (hw : k w = s)
    (hLi : ∀ i, ∃ (N : W.Modules) (_ : N.IsFiniteLocallyFree),
      Nonempty ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst (fi i) k)).obj
        ((Modules.tensorPullback (ui i)).obj L) ≅
        (Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (fi i) k)).obj N))
    (hLs : ∃ (N : (Spec (S.residueField s)).Modules) (_ : N.IsFiniteLocallyFree),
      Nonempty ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (S.fromSpecResidueField s))).obj L ≅
        (Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd f (S.fromSpecResidueField s))).obj N)) :
    let E := ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f k)).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f k)).obj L)))
    ∃ (U : W.Opens) (hwU : w ∈ U), IsAffineOpen U ∧
      (∀ i, Nonempty
        ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst (fi i) (U.ι ≫ k))).obj
          ((Modules.tensorPullback (ui i)).obj L) ≅
          SheafOfModules.unit (pullback (fi i) (U.ι ≫ k)).ringCatSheaf)) ∧
      ∃ (m : ℕ) (K : CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ),
        (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ j : ℤ, j < a ∨ b < j → IsZero (K.X j)) ∧
        (∀ j : ℤ, j < 0 → derivedFiberBetti W E j w = 0) ∧
        (∀ j : ℤ, Nonempty (K.X j ≅ SheafOfModules.free
          (R := (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)
          (ULift.{v} (Fin (derivedFiberBetti W E j w))))) ∧
        ∃ (e0 : (K.X 0).val.obj (.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) ≃ₗ[Γ(W, U)] Γ(W, U))
          (e1 : (K.X 1).val.obj (.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) ≃ₗ[Γ(W, U)] (Fin m → Γ(W, U))),
          Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{v}
            (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj E ≅
              DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) ∧
          ∀ i, W.evaluation U w hwU
            (e1 ((K.d 0 1).val.app (.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) (e0.symm 1)) i) = 0
